MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 27, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:02 a.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl (arrived at 8:04 a.m.), Trustee Chien (arrived at
  8:05 a.m.), Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Alternate Wu

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared that he attended the Crain Art Gallery reception on Saturday, which
he enjoyed. He added that it was pouring rain that day and Library staff handled the issues that came
up as a result of the rain well.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Trustee Osegueda shared that she’s been communicating with Youth Services Librarian Torres to
set up library visits for the remaining of the school year and early next school year, and to get
students signed up for library cards.

Alternate Wahl, Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry, and Vice Chairperson Sadun did not have anything to
report.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that the new exhibit, featuring artists from South Pasadena of Studio
1034, will remain on display until March 31. She added that the following exhibit will feature
watercolors and oils of Vivienne Oldknow and Tina Chong from April 8 – May 19, followed by a
Chinese calligrapher from May 27 to July 7, with a reception on June 3.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 27, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Derry shared that the Friends are planning for their anniversary party on April 21 with help
from Cindy. She added that the Book Shoppe is doing very well.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien reported that the Foundation still has concerns about the lack of coverage for the
Library’s Open House event. She asked if the Board can help with media coverage and sharing
information with residents. She added that the Foundation is thinking about a smaller scale event to
thank donors.

NEW BUSINESS

6. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Vice Chairperson Sadun moved, seconded by Trustee Chien, to approve the minutes from January
23, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  None

7. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

There was discussion by the Board regarding the progression and timeline of the San Marino Center
project. Director Johnson provided several status updates on the project including that the project
is currently on time, the plan is to have a re-grand opening in August or September, and she is
working to amend the existing parking agreement with the School District.

There was also discussion by the Board regarding fine free libraries and how these policies affect
the number of returned items and patrons who come back to libraries. The Board requested that
staff provide further information on the Library’s current policy and a recommendation moving
forward.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

  THE LIBRARY DIVISION

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Vice Chairperson  Sadun,  to  support  staffs
recommendations of the two CIP projects for FY 2023-24.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Dornier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  None
